title: SAP MCP calls fail: cookie expired, server answers with the HTML login page
symptom: sap-doctor: 'cookie rejected (got 200 text/html …)'; MCP read fails with 'expected element type <objectReferences> but have <html>'.
rootCause: The SSO session cookie in tools/vsp/cookies_*.txt has expired (seen after ~7 days).

solutions.label: Refresh with vsp --browser-auth, then restart VS Code
solutions.body: Skill sap-doctor step 3: close Chrome first, run vsp with --browser-exec Chrome and --cookie-save per tenant in the background, user logs in, restart VS Code (vsp reads the cookie only at start).

prevention: Run sap-doctor at session start / new day.
evidence: this session 2026-10-05: sap-doctor FAIL on both clients (cookie 161h old) -> refresh -> PASS, search ZCL_* returned rows on both servers
